summary.framework_finding: The J-Book divergence pattern does not fire against RTX at the 2023-01-15 cutoff: every J-Book-grounded RTX program (LRSO, NGI, F135, F119, LTAMDS, AMRAAM, Standard Missile family, AIM-9X, ESSM, Stinger, Patriot, Hypersonic, TPY-2, NASAMS, NGJ, SPY-6, StormBreaker) is either OUTSIDE the seeded 410-PE corpus (which is skewed to small-cap-relevant DARPA/MDA/SOCOM/Air Force/Space Force RDT&E PEs) or returns NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE because the FY26 corpus has no backfill to FY23. Per heuristic #7, NOT_FOUND ≠ red flag; per the catalog NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE → UNVERIFIABLE. usaspending confirms Raytheon's $42.5B / 14,398-award DoD scale pre-cutoff, supporting (not contradicting) the prime-contractor narrative. Conclusion: no negative J-Book divergence signal detected; framework correctly avoids false positive on a megacap whose disclosure is well-aligned with the J-Book corpus it CAN see.
